source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_blocks = []
    start = 0
    for r in sep_rows + [h]:
        if start < r:
            row_blocks.append((start, r))
        start = r + 1
    col_blocks = []
    start = 0
    for c in sep_cols + [w]:
        if start < c:
            col_blocks.append((start, c))
        start = c + 1
    cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in sep_rows for c in range(w) if c not in sep_cols]
    background = Counter(cells).most_common(1)[0][0]
    special = next(value for value in set(cells) if value != background)
    return [[2 if sum(grid[r][c] == special for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)) == 1 else 1
             for c0, c1 in col_blocks] for r0, r1 in row_blocks]
'''
